_comment: Per-series cadence/publish-lag overrides for heartbeat.classify. Keys are exact series_id or a 'prefix.*' glob. cadence_days forces the cadence; publish_lag_days is subtracted from elapsed so a feed's inherent publish lag isn't read as overdue. Keeps STALE/DEAD meaningful (a feed past lag+2x cadence still trips).
_fx_comment: FRED H.10 daily-FX rates publish in weekly batches ~1wk late (verified vs FRED's own keyless CSV 2026-08-03: latest obs was 07-24, our DB matched exactly). The generic fred.* 3-day lag is too short; these get 7. Still trips STALE on a real multi-week break.
_gas_comment: GASREGW is WEEKLY retail gasoline; the fred.* glob wrongly forced it to daily cadence, so a normal 7-day gap read STALE. Restore weekly cadence.
_vc_comment: VISION_ROADMAP V1 value-chain nodes. The two PPI series are MONTHLY and post ~mid the following month (a June point is normal until ~mid-Aug), so cadence 30 + ~25d lag. The EIA daily petroleum spots (Gulf gasoline, Mont Belvieu propane) publish ~1wk late like the FX H.10 series.
_spot_comment: 2026-09-02: the EIA daily petroleum spots FRED re-publishes (Brent, WTI, Henry Hub, NY Harbor heating oil) post in weekly batches ~1wk late, exactly like DGASUSGULF/DPROPANEMBTX above (verified 2026-09-02: FRED's own CSV ended 08-25 on 09-02). Same 7-day lag; a real multi-week break still trips.
_wtisplc_comment: fred.WTISPLC is the MONTHLY 1946+ spine; the fred.* glob forced daily cadence so it read DEAD at 60/4 on 09-02 with July posted. FRED posts each month's value in the first half of the following month: cadence 30 + 20d lag.
